title: Exclusively Niche Buyers
scenario: Find 'customer_id' who only bought products that nobody else bought.
hint: Find products with count(customer_id) = 1, then find customers who only bought these.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM customer GROUP BY product_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) = 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 1), (2, 2);
